name: atom-updater
description: Periodically checks for new Atom++ releases and notifies you with a download link. Notify-only — never auto-applies, so it works on any build with no code-signing.

atompp.update.enabled.description: Periodically check for new Atom++ releases and notify with a download link (does not auto-install).

atompp.update.url.description: Update feed base URL. Overrides product.json updateUrl. Leave blank to use product.json. For local testing, point at the reference update server (e.g. http://localhost:9696).

atompp.update.intervalHours.description: How often to check for updates, in hours.
